outcome: Postpartum permanent contraception fulfillment (before discharge, within 42 days, within 365 days)
cohort: 3,013 patients with a documented contraceptive plan of permanent contraception at postpartum discharge, comparing those with Medicaid insurance vs. private insurance
finding: Patients with Medicaid insurance were less likely to receive desired permanent contraception before hospital discharge, within 42 days, and within 365 days postpartum compared to those with private insurance, even after adjusting for clinical and demographic factors.
mod_finding: This study examined the association between Medicaid insurance and postpartum permanent contraception fulfillment, and did not report on mode of delivery.
